Personal Finance & Expense Tracking.title: Money Manager Expense & Budget
pain_points: I paid for the premium version of this app and have been using it steadily for over two weeks now, monitoring my expenses and income. After inputting a lot of data, the app suddenly reverted to the free version. And there is no way for me to get back to the paid version that I paid for. I went to the help center and followed the instructions of uninstalling the app and re-installing it, then restoring the backup. None of that worked. So now I'm stucked, money and time wasted. This is annoying.

Not for me. I don't have time to stop and enter an expense everything I go to a convenience store, get gas in my car, or go to a restaurant. I have bank statements that track my spending, and I can look at those on my phone on my banking app and credit card apps and see all of my spending, what I spent on, and a simple calculator can tell me how much I spend per category. Not functional enough to compensate for time taken out of my day to enter all in. It should link to $ my accounts

Pretty good, still needs a lot of work. Top thing needs to be that when I have something recurring. Stop making it wait till next month to show in the calendar. I'm constantly having to add stuff just to see next month and having to delete it next month when it auto shows. Very annoying. Every other apps have options for recurring timing and fill each month out to that limit. Edit: to the response from the dev. that's exactly the problem. it only works on the first of the month.

I've had this app for several years, and I really hate the update. I used to be ablez to edit reoccurring payments/income (if either of us got a pay raise, I could edit our reoccurring salary, if a reoccurring expense went up or down or was completely removed, I could easily edit it). NOW I cannot for the life of me figure out how to change reoccurring salaries/expenses, and I'm about 2 seconds from deleting the app.

This app does not keep the correct totals. I don't know what it's doing but I've used several apps to track my money and they all kept the totals right. This one doesn't. I constantly have to adjust it, which is ridiculous and defeats the purpose of keeping track. Bad, useless, app.

Personal Finance & Expense Tracking.title: Money manager & expenses
pain_points: Reduce the one time pay fee on the app, the ads are getting increasingly intrusive and longer in duration, I use this app but despise the ads and overly costly onetime fee, that now I force close the app and reopen just to bypass the increasingly intrusive ads that play right in the middle I am adding expenses. as of July 31, 2026 I can no longer use the app without having to sign up for a trial subscription, this app has gotten worse over time and would pass this one over.

This is a simple, easy to use app. However, it has intrusive ads, that you can only turn off with giving the developer money. Which means you can't even figure out all the the features available without paying. Then when you go to the convenient little tab to rate the app, the only option it gives you is five stars. I'm out.

Deleted 10 min after installing. It honestly started out looking pretty helpful. I entered my account balance, and went to enter my upcoming bills. Which couldn't be accomplished because they were more than two days out, one was three. I do not see how an app that will not except a preset payment process can help budget anything.

Many similar apps are out there doing the same thing. And this app does the work as expected. I don't want to pay for a monthly fee by using the app. If it has a low cost life time no ad version, I may consider buying it once. Update on 3/21/2024 The app doesn't work well on Android 15 UI 6.0. Are you guys going to provide patch shortly? I was unable to launch the application and the app didn't open.
Was a reasonable app and quite useful when I needed it. Now that I don't, I'm having issues canceling and stopping the auto billing. How do I cancel?

Personal Finance & Expense Tracking.title: Money Tracker-Expense & Budget
pain_points: Had the previous version on an older phone. Loved it. Installed this one on my new phone... what happened? It's clunky. The screen is cluttered. Even the font is a poor choice. Color coding of categories is gone. Monochrome and poor navigation astound the app forced me to uninstall. Very disappointing. Ya fixed something that wasn't broke.

Recurring transactions keep coming back after I delete them. I cleared the cache, reinstalled the app, and deleted them multiple times, but they still reappear. This makes the tracker unreliable because removed transactions keep affecting the records. Please fix this bug.
It's simple yes but it'd be nicer if it could add more notes to the entries. The ads are annoying.
this app is not collaging data automatically from sms as well.as CSV files and pdf files ...very disappoint even if I have taken paid membership yesterday -please fix issue asap and let me know

UI isn't same as the pictures shown on preview, feature has 3 things only: incomes, expenses, and balance. But it DRAIN BATTERY LIKE INSANE. Charging couldn't even get battery up, force stop also doesn't help, uninstalled and my phone battery became normal again. Just wth did this app need that much battery? Not even heavy games are like this.

Personal Finance & Expense Tracking.title: MyMoney—Track Expense & Budget
pain_points: The app is great.. I want to buy the premium version but two nifty feature is missing..Number 1 and the most important one. It should show the total Amount earned and spent on a certain day right beside the date. This is a deal breaker. At the end on the day I want to see how much money I have spent at a glance instead of calculating. Number two is the ability to set a default account for expenses so that I don't have to add that every time.

I like the simplicity and nice interface of the app but at least the yearly view and custom view of expenses should be offered in the free version otherwise what's the point. Anyway y'all aren't offering custom time period budgets or good filters to find out certain expenses at least y'all can offer the basic viewing option.

Very good app helps a lot with money management. Really wish there was a daily, weekly budget feature to help set and keep track of spending on a more refined basis as well as a debt management section specifically catered management of loans advances, etc. the ability to take pictures of and scan receipts and categorize them based on what is scanned. Otherwise, great app
Not being able to export or back-up the data and keeps crashing when I try to export the record in csv file. Please fix this issue or I'll lose all of my records ,fixx
This app is wonderful, but then it still lacks of uploading receipts for each expenditure. if it had, it would be amazing

Personal Finance & Expense Tracking.title: Splid – Split group bills
pain_points: I paid for a Plus subscription and the option to export expenses somehow disappeared, now I can't export at all. I'm revoking my 5* review until support fixes this. What's going on with Splid? I see no effort from the developer in improving the app, improvement suggestions I made in the past were ignored. Suggestions for the Expenses screen: 1. Show expense date, 2. Show label, 3. Assign different icons for each label. UI improvements make paying customers happy.

Everyone is right, math is inaccurate. I use Receipt Ninja but was looking for a more elegant way for everyone to see expenses and who owes what. I compared the two. The total spent is correct on both; what individuals paid is not. I spent $193.87 but this app says I spent $107.07. My total reimbursement is less than should be and higher than should be for others. We had very uneven splitting based on number in each family & participant. I'm sure that had something to do with it. Uninstalling.

I cannot find the option to share a bill not as 50-50%, I would like to add different amount to each person. I don't seem to find that function on it. I am actually not happy with this app. I could have just written it down myself. It's very basic. Maybe you should look into to make the tabs easier to use and to understand. And have an option not just to split the bill 50percent but also simply with different amount. I'm sorr but I'm not happy with this app.

UPDATED. I have not received any support and a month has passed from email. I am looking for a new App... I need support to export my data to Excel. i paid for the plus option and it is not providing that option. I have emailed customer support twice, but have not received feedback.

Very basic app!. Data entry is infuriating doesn't even add today's date as a default to the entry. You have expand the form every time. Needed to export MY data and paid the fee, but I still have no way to export with in the app! Tried to contact Nico, but a week later there is still no response!

Habit & ADHD / Productivity.title: Routine Planner, Habit Tracker
pain_points: I'm unimpressed. Besides the app harassing you to subscribe, I didn't even get through one routine without it bugging out. If you're thinking that you can use this app to give you a quiet "ding" when it's time to move to the next thing, you can't. It's either a text to speech voice or push notification. There's no way to set habits that don't use a routine so you can't say make hourly water reminders. Not worth $30.

The app does not notify me when the time is up. I have the "voice notifications" turned on (even though I would like a simple ping), my phone is not silent, I allowed the app to share notifications with me. I have no idea why it wouldn't send a notification. I tried keeping the phone's display on, turning it off, turning battery saving mode on and off. I increased my phone's media and ringtone volume, as well as the app's timer volume.

Update: So I originally signed up for the monthly subscription and then changed my mind and decided to get the yearly subscription. Apparently doing that does not automatically cancel the monthly subscription so I got charged for another month even though I already paid for the year... I have never experienced this issue with any other app that has multiple subscription options. This app is really helpful. I had ADHD and struggle with time blindness. The app keeps me on track on.

App crashes whenever I try to sign in. Extremely frustrating, since I'm paying for online backups. 8 months later, and this issue has still not been fixed. Update: have reached out 3 times regarding this issue, and the company can't seem to fix it. Asked for a refund, and they didn't respond. I would look elsewhere for a routine app.

I absolutely love this app and use it almost daily. it really helps with time blindness. however, yesterday it was crashing every time I opened it. I ended up deleting the app and redownloading it to see if that will help. Now, I'm not able to log in. I can't sign in to my existing account nor create a new account. I'm upset about this because of how much I use the app.

Habit & ADHD / Productivity.title: Habitoria – ADHD Habit Tracker
pain_points: makes me waste time to take a survey and have to pay for a payment plan lime what are we doing

Habit & ADHD / Productivity.title: Daily Planner, To Do List
pain_points: everything you try to do, routes you immediately to expensive paid options. I mean nearly every single button you click. even if you x out, it comes right back after 1 click. People say there are free options- if thats the case then the app needs to be easier to navigate and allow you to find those things without forcing you to a pay screen every 15 seconds. pretty sure I couldnt even save after editing a template because it wanted me to pay. predatory. rating so that I remember not to waste

too many pop-ups. 2-3 minimum every time I change a page. then it stopped giving me access to my to-do list that I typed up unless I paid for the subscription. I downloaded this app because I wanted a nice planner/to-do list with a widget to prep for my flight later today and not only has it made the last hour of my life worse, the widget doesn't even show the list. this app is the antithesis to productivity

Tried to move around app to get familiar and create my page. EVERY TIME I clicked on something I got pop ups to subscribe, sometimes 2 pop ups. Not able to explore app without having to close a pop up at every turn. Closed 14 pop ups before quitting! Hate that - I will not subscribe to an app I don't know will fill my needs Ridiculous! 😡

1. Needs the ability to create an account without Google or Apple, such as with an email. 2. Needs to have more features than just blank pages for the free version, not everything available, but have some templates available in each category. I'm not going to pay for an app I can't try before buying. 3. Needs to stop having the purchase pop up every time I click something.

It looks like a great App that is flexible and customizable to the point you can bring in your own planners without the subscription which is great if you want that. However upon opening the app for the first time the choices for "what best describes you" heavily gives assumption that the user is female which personally is a major turn off and there is no way easy way to find the free pre-made planers. Plus everytime I clicked into a new screen I had to close three ads asking me to subscribe.

Habit & ADHD / Productivity.title: Todoery: To Do List & Planner
pain_points: It works but the ads, both self promoting and for other brands have me about ready to uninstall after just one week. It's supposed to be something you can pop in quick to add a new item or check something off but you constantly get stopped by full screen ads. Edit: I'm always happy to pay for an app I use and like directly to remove ads. But all I see for this app is a donation button

I cannot in good faith recommend this app. First thing that pops up when I open the app is their premium, which is over $30 for lifetime price. Click out of it, and another pop up asking me if I'm sure I want to skip out on the offer, I say yes and I close out of that as well. So I set up my first reminder and all seems to be going well, except for when I go to adjust the schedule. For some odd reason, you cannot adjust what days it goes off without paying, and weekends are auto excluded.

Still not certain what this app has to do with milk products. Even if you add shopping lists to it, that isn't part of the main function. Not a good "omen". Installed anyway in desperation. [6 apps in 2 days.] Discovered that Daily reminder isn't available for the free version. Uninstalled. Clue: Banner style ads at top of app would bring funds/not interfere with use. If they change every 15 secs, that's a lot of revenue.

For a simple to-do list app, the marketing and ads are aggressive. Opening the app you're requested to subscribe, and when you say you don't want to it opens a new pop up asking you to subscribe, just in case you didn't mean it before. Once you get past those pop ups you can finally start adding tasks, but you'll still have annoying subscription offer ads pop up when you open the app/appear in your task list. And they'll notify you of subscription offers, which you can't shut off.

The free version is really just a come-on for their paid product. The free version is extremely limited and impoßible to actually use. Constantly interrupted by ads you can't click out of. They demanded star rating after I'd barely started my first list and hadn't even used it yet. Couldn't move out of that demand either; had to close app to avoid rating. Need to pay $ to create >1 extra category beyond their few. I was mislead by the colors of their logo, thought it was a Google app.

Habit & ADHD / Productivity.title: Focus To-Do: Pomodoro & Tasks
pain_points: I've used the paid version for almost two years. But it has stopped working properly. It won't sync. It won't upgrade to the latest version. The Forest feature hasn't worked for months. It keeps telling me to uninstall/reinstall the app, but because it won't sync, I am afraid I will lose two years of carefully built repeat routines. Customer support was useless, emailing vague, unhelpful questions every two to three days, then ghosting me. I am so frustrated. Don't trust this app!

I have the same problem like other users having to pay again. I am not sure if the update reset everything. I tried sending emails with some questions. the address doesnt work and bounced twice. why are there two different prices and why do I have to pay for the phone and the desktop version? it would be great if there was tagging system and have different pomodoro settings for different occasions. if the payment is not sorted soon I am going to ask for a refund.

Was a great app unfortunately you need premium to use it's core features after two days. I understand that the devs gotta eat, but they should be using a freemium model with ads. The fact that they aren't is disappointing. I spend so much time looking at this app anyway that it makes no sense not to include ads. Not like you can't record how much time is being spent looking at ads.

Don't get it if you ever think you'll need to reach out to customer service. There was an issue with a purchase, so that same day, I asked for a refund. The only way to contact them is through an email address. Their response time and communication has been poor. Over several days, I've sent 4 emails explaining the situation and asking for a refund. The only response I've gotten back was them telling me I have the subscription and to check my account.

In the pixel watch, the timer frequently stops with a notification saying the phone app needs more permission. This does not go away even though I have given it permission. Although, I think it should not ask for that permission at all. It would be nice if the app could run on the watch without needing an active connection with the phone.

Habit & ADHD / Productivity.title: Pomodoro Timer
pain_points: Sadly doesn't work anymore. It worked when I first downloaded it a long time ago. Since then I've reinstalled it, checked all the settings, checked that my phone wasn't set to snooze it or something, I've even tried keeping my screen on the whole time the timers are running. No matter what I do, when it gets to the end of a timer, it doesn't make a peep, doesn't move on to the next timer, just sits there at 0 seconds remaining. Sometimes it'll stop at 4 seconds remaining.

The idea is great. the app helped me stay productive and organized, that is, when it worked. Unfortunately it's full of bugs. 60% of the time it "forgets" to notify me, and sometimes it counts down past 0 (I noticed that on short breaks. if the app is open and the screen is on, after it reaches 0, it starts counting into negative time instead of stopping and notifying me.) This app deserves a 5 star rating if it wasn't for those bugs.

The alarm doesn't go off unless you have your phone's notification sounds on. That makes it kind of pointless, because text messages and other notifs will ding while I'm trying to focus. But if I turn notification sounds off, I won't know when the pomodoro timer ends. I wish it used other sounds, like media or alarm sounds. Admittedly, it's partially my phone's fault for being so convoluted haha (Pixel). If there's a way to silence everything on my phone except for this app, let me know.

I used to love this app but for the past several months, when the pomodoro is done, it doesn't ring and instead of starting a short break, it keeps counting time in the negatives (even with all the settings for auto start breaks and rings and notifications on, and even with the phone unlocked). There are no updates to the app and I even emailed them to get it fixed but got no response. I liked that this app is simple, straightforward and doesn't have any ads but it just doesn't work anymore.

Had high hopes for this. Design is nice and simple. However, it worked only once, giving me the 25 minute cycle followed by a 5 minute break and then switched inexplicably to a 1 minute cycle that I could not change. When I tried to access it's menu, the app would simply hang and fail. Very frustrating. If it actually worked, I'd have given it 5.

Health, Fasting & Nutrition.title: Fasting - Intermittent Fasting
pain_points: Only option in the manual entry is for carbs protein and fat, can't change grams to milligrams or add sugar content when creating manual entry. And all of the search results are incorrect. no option to edit anything that comes up in the search. very poor app for actually tracking calories and food intake. sucks I got tricked into buying a full year with their discount and now I'm stuck with this app.

I'm just editing to add that technical support emailed me this same response, blaming me for the issue. It's not difficult app to use on my side. It's just not doing what it is supposed to. It is impossible to set a schedule. I set my plan to break the fasting on Saturday and Sunday, but when I go to start the plan, it randomly selects two days to break the fasting. Incredibly annoying, especially being a premium plan user.

With this app, I decided to go with a 7 day trial for 5.15. The app referred me to another app. FastEasy I paid for the trial when I looked at my statement, they charged me another 15.19. When I questioned the charge, they stated that because I opened a meal planner, it charged me for the additional feature. At no time did a pop-up state there would be an additional charge. I just thought it was included. Not happy

I used this app to great success several years ago and it did everything I needed it to do in a nice package. Came back after a couple of years off, figured I'd give them a few bucks for the ad free version, then found out that everything useful - even simple, simple things like setting my own daily schedule - are locked behind a subscription paywall. Absolutely ridiculous. There are far better options available.

I thought this was going to be a great free app to track fasting. But it's not. I set my fasting period to start at 7pm and end at 9am the next day. But the app will not stop the counting of fasting automatically. So rather than it ending my fasting time I have to go in and change it. And if I forget to stop the clock I can't go back and edit the end time. It told me I was fasting for 24 hours and I wasn't. Poor user quality in my opinion.

Health, Fasting & Nutrition.title: Intermittent Fasting Tracker
pain_points: Unfortunately this app is not adaptable. My prefered fasting period is 19:5 but the app will only accept 18:6 or 20:4 do I am unable to use it.

Health, Fasting & Nutrition.title: Drink Water Reminder & Tracker
pain_points: Update: I have used Water Tracker for several years and it has been very helpful to ensure I hydrate properly every day. Now the app has an ad banner at the bottom as well as a reminder banner. Neither can be closed so I can't add the amount of water because the banners cover the amounts consumed, rendering the app useless to me. My rating went from 5 stars to one since I can no longer add water amounts consumed. Time to find another water tracker app.

Thought it was the best water tracker with widgets & all but the reminder does not work at all. Only gave a reminder once at the start of the day and never does it again after every 2 hrs. I downloaded 4 water reminder apps to compare and this is the only app that ain't working with reminders. Did all the troubleshooting as I really like the app compared to the rest but it just does not work. And as for battery usage this consumed more as I tried the widget 2% with no notif while others at 1.8%

P.o.s,if the app worked as well as the ads on it does, then it would work fine. However it doesn't. Enjoy tracking water and coffee only.. been using this app for over a year, i regret not finding something better in that timeframe. UPDATE & RESPONSE: and for the price of a cup of tea i could to.....but i wouldn't be able to log said cup of Tea otherwise.....

Sooo the app started malfunctioning. Too bad too cause it was working fine til it wasn't. I set my reminder for every 2 hours which is 120 minutes, today it decided it wanted to remind me every 15 minutes. Did some trouble shooting & nothing worked. So Goodbye, it was good while it lasted. Downloading another app.

Used it very contentedly for a long time. Then it added advertising. Then it cut functions. It is now so annoying I'm deleting it to start over. If anyone from the company that makes thus app is reading: You don't not build loyalty by steadily making the experience more limited, more grating, more demanding and useless.

Health, Fasting & Nutrition.title: Water Reminder - Remind Drink
pain_points: I don't care about tracking the amount, so I'm just using this app to remind me every half hour to drink water. I knocked off a star because the notification goes off twice at the start of the day and my reminder schedule gets wiped out if i change my wake up or bedtime settings. Update: after a few days I stopped getting notifications so I guess I'll have to try another app.

It suggests 39 fl oz a day for me. For my body weight, I should be closer to 67 oz. Why is that suggestion so off? Also, the app keeps disappearing when I tab out, then I have to go through ALL my apps just to open it again even though I did not close it and it was NOT killed. - Edit: It STILL wasn't adjusting correctly. Had to set my weight from 105 to 152 just to get the right adjustments. EDIT 2X - I CAN'T INPUT 9.5 BECAUSE IT THINKS IT'S LESS THAN 0. THIS APP SUCKS.

I'm not really getting reminder... I need to actually open my notification tray, it doesn't appear on the bar at the top or on the home screen when my phone is locked... And that's only when I'm actually getting notifications. Which I'm not for most of the time, despite having made sure that my notifications settings were set up properly (and yes I am absolutely sure they are, not technologically illiterate. That's an issue unique to this app.)

This app literally told me I need to drink 3,190oz of water a day. That's almost 25 gallons solely based on my weight. Drinking that much would cause fatal water intoxication. So based on nothing but my weight, this app is suggested toxic and dangerous amounts of water! And additionally, it would not let me adjust the goal to lower than 90oz. I absolutely do NOT recommend taking the advice of this app, instead ask a doctor for a recommendation.

I used to quite like this app but the last few times I've opened it music from presumably some ad just plays on an endless loop until I close the app. I've tried watching a video to get rid of the ads or clicking off every ad I see, but the music doesn't stop as long as the app stays open. I can't use it like this and until it's fixed, I won't use it.

Health, Fasting & Nutrition.title: Hevy - Gym Log Workout Tracker
pain_points: I purchased the lifetime version. Notes are not saved for the next workout; that is a basic and essential feature. Edit workout has a bug 🐛 in the latest release. It is not possible to update values; it jumps below, and it is impossible to update the workout. Please fix that very annoying bug that impacts the user experience, as it is a basic and essential edit function.

I purchased Hevy's lifetime version and really want to give a 5-star review, but one major issue holds up my workout flow. I track progress by noting my levels and RPM. However, when starting a new workout, notes from the previous session don't copy over into the new editable field, and any pre-filled text auto-deletes when I start typing. I'm forced to memorize or screenshot past notes. It's imperative that previous notes copy over and remain editable so we can easily update them!

Only four workouts, so if you want to have as little as a one-week cycle, pay up. It's also plagued with social media content, as that's the first page you see when you open the app. Fairly straightforward to use, but the limited functionality makes the free version useless. I'm sure the social media garbage doesn't go away with the paid version, either.

Tried to create a routine and the moment I had more than a couple exercises in it I had to start saving and updating the routine after adding an exercise. Then going back in and editing it to be able to add sets or more exercises all the buttons in the UI of the routine would not let me add more sets or exercises after adding one or the other. Glad I didn't go with Pro and waste money on it.

The app on Wear OS. Samsung Galaxy Watch is terrible. When you scroll to change the reps, it skips over by 2, you have to keep messing around with it until it finally selects the number you want. Also other apps have music integration in it, this does not. Look elsewhere if you want a workout logger that works well on your wearable.

Health, Fasting & Nutrition.title: Simple Workout Log
pain_points: Only rating it as 1 star so the dev can see this(will remove soon). What most of the low reviews don't understand is that this isn't an app for automation. It's supposed to be you tracking everything as this app is meant to be like a more simple notepad with simple features that more popular apps seem to forget(such as adding your own exercise). While the dev does leave snarky remarks on low reviews it doesn't take away from the fact that the app is a great way to track your progression.

Terrible. You can't even add info/notes like the weight you do them. im better off using a notepad. Edit: Thank you devs for your rude response. I have no doubt that you "don't know how it could be simpler", based on your current lack of options (ie. notes, weights, etc), which you can not save to the exercises

I backed this up before switching phones, but nothing switched over to new phone. Including ad free. So disappointing. Ok. Figured out how to remove ads, but the built in cloud on the app did not save my info. So, that sucks.

Good concept for single sets only. Used it this morning to log my first workout with it and it didn't record 2/3 of my sets. Only recorded 1 set for each exercise, I guess if you're like me and do supersets you should look for something different. Everytime I switched between exercises it deleted the first one so it only showed I did 1 set of each. Not very helpful when doing drop set supersets.

I liked the simplicity of the app, but like nearly every "free" app, the obnoxious ads banner completely ruins an otherwise good workout tracker because it's right in the middle of the phone screen and flashes. Screw that.

Students & Study Utilities.title: Brainscape: Study Flashcards
pain_points: Classic bait and switch. No pricing information anywhere, they wait for you to spend time building a deck and then force you to pay extreme prices just to use it. Their app is also not GDPR complaint, I had no way to export my data without paying a fee, which is in violation of law. I even had to install the app just to delete my account which I'm sure is also not compliant.  I will use Anki, this is a rip off.

I used to love this app so much I paid premium for 2yrs. Not cheap for student. Unfortunately, switching from iPhone to Android, the functions I paid for aren't available. The ability to choose length of study session per deck and grading results is gone. On Android, it infinitely loops deck until I quit and only gives aggregated grade. Now, it's as useful as a notepad app. Customer service promised patch over a year ago and it never came. Now trying to get refund on renewal charge.

The functionality is good up to a point. I like the system of showing you cards you aren't as good with, and of letting you rate your callback of each one 1-5. However, you cannot study cards in reverse. Supposedly this is possible with a pro subscription ($10/mo...) but I just upgraded and still don't have this improved functionality. This app wasted my money and my time, as I now have to figure out a new flashcard app that actually works as it says and re-upload all of my terms/definitions.

$20 for 1 month to use all the flashcards?? Dang how much money you think we got in the economy. I'd charge you $20 for the audacity. Reply: No I won't be using this app. I was recommended it by a colleague, but he was able to buy pro at half the price. I'd have considered it then. $20 a month is exorbitant, and "keep the lights on" is a terrible justification. "As you may know" = gaslighting. No, I don't know why this software deserves that much money when others are just as good AND cheaper.

I bought a subscription for one month to add pictures to my flashcards. I can only put one picture, but that is the small problem. Almost every time when I am editing the flashcard on my phone, when replacing the picture, I get an error. I cannot recomand this app!

Students & Study Utilities.title: AnkiDroid Flashcards
pain_points: No random repeats (it repeats only two last cards in a loop). It doesn't select all cards from inlayed decks. It sees the cards, it allows you to choose them for repeating and... nothing happens. You have to manually go through every deck. I'd say that the software is just raw, but it's been on the market for long enough. So, I guess, it's just bad software. [Samsung Galaxy Tab A9 Samsung Galaxy A15] -upd: new version has the same bugs

None of my added cards saved. I'm a med student and I am making high effort, complicated cards. Just finished making a batch of 40 different cards and none of them were saved. Safe to say I am extremely disappointed and have nothing to show for my work. I don't know if this is a bug present across all platforms, but please fix this. Just leads to frustration and lost productivity! I probably will stop using this program because I can't take any more risks.

I ran into an issue where after testing a few flash cards I made, it kept telling me congratulations and to adjust study settings to study outside the study limit. or something along those lines. I'm just looking for something I can just keep flipping through at any moment I have time. I went through the settings to try disabling this "limit" feature and couldn't find anything that would work. Why is there even this limitation to begin with?

I like the app but I'm hit a problem and unable to run with latest update. It says: "Please grant AnkiDroid the 'Storage' permission to continue." However, I have enabled all permissions that are requested and it still doesn't run. The app does not seem to be requesting access to the shared folder so I can't grant it permission. This bug needs to be addressed asap!

The app works well but the data collection makes this a no go app. I do not feel comfortable with my data being collected or sold to third party vendors... Make a paid version for people that wish to retain their privacy whilst also allowing them to enjoy the app.

Students & Study Utilities.title: Adobe Scan AI PDF Scanner, OCR
pain_points: Great app. Easy to use. This is true for the free Adobe scan app. However the Adobe scan AI premium is a mediocre product at best. They advertise for a 7-Day free trial. I found out the hard way that is not true. Once you start to sign up for the product and you change it to pay by monthly, magically the 7-Day free trial vanishes without any warning. I downloaded the app tried it for 20 minutes - unimpressed. Cancelled the product within 20 minutes. No refunds. Totally wrong!

These monthly subscription fees are apt to drive most people to bankruptcy... I get it, you've developed a brilliant piece of mobile software and you want to be fairly compensated for it's use. However, keep in mind that the average consumer will have 20-40 other pieces of software or streaming services all clamoring for monthly subscription fees at similar price points. We can't afford it. If it were a one-time $10-25, maybe. But $9.99/monthly?? Not going to happen.

Of course a basic product can't just exist. There has to be a subscription attached to it. Not a good move when there are 10 million other options to scan and combine documents. But what else is to be expected from Adobe? Inferior products at higher prices. At the end of the day, this is a good thing. I'm now motivated to look at smaller and/or better companies. And thus we are that much closer to rendering Adobe irrelevant.

The auto crop feature does not appear to be something you can turn off, and it constantly tries to crop off half of the document I am scanning. I shouldn't have to fight the app to get exactly what I want. Additionally, there currently is no local storage option. The app isn't so bad it's unusable, but other apps are outright better so there isn't a point to ever using this one in any use case.

I do not recommend this app, especially for anyone with a business. When you pay the ten dollars, you don't get what you pay for. I paid the $10 a month and the converted PDF file would not open very easily on word or excel. Even though the setting was set for that plus the words were all mixed up and the lines were all mixed up. Plus I also found out if you get a samsung galaxy s24 phone it will do a better job for free, check it out.

Students & Study Utilities.title: CamScanner- scanner, PDF maker
pain_points: This app used to be good. I use a scanner app to submit things for school, and I used to love using camscanner. Now there's so many ads that I can't even open the app without waiting through several ads and then another 3 ads between each picture, and another 4 ads when I'm trying to rename the document. I've missed last minute deadlines because I was unable to submit my assignment on time because of so many ads wasting my time. Just simply disappointing :/

This app used to be amazing. The app has become unusable for me because of the ad interruptions. I went to purchase it thinking it would be around $4.99 as a 1 time purchase. To find out they want $29 for a year is ridiculous in my opinion. Turns out "Drive Scan" by Google is free, and does exactly the same thing I have been using Camscanner for.

this used to be a 5-star app, but ads have become so intrusive. this morning was the last straw and reason for the review. I was simply trying to scan a single page doc and share it. I ended up getting passed over to the play store 3 times from two ads and finally had to close the app entirely just to get back to where I could select my scanned doc to share. I had to close it because it was stuck on an ad and the close button was frozen under the top status/notification bar of my phone.

Maybe mid spring of 2026, I tried CamScanner for the first time. I fell in love with it. I could scan papers or receipts or photos without problem and get a very clear and vivid scan. But as of very recent. I find that I cannot use the app without a whole bunch of advertisements interrupting the scanning process or asking for updates or subscriptions. Alternatives only scan to PDF (not to JPG like CamScanner) and are more complicated overall to use. But I have to find an alternative. :(

The app used to be great but now it's just $$. I even have my edu premium benefits. However, even with that, I can't create folders without paying anymore. I can not even reorder a scanning that I just took pictures without paying. you know what! keep your app. There are much better options that won't keep on asking for money for every feature

Students & Study Utilities.title: My Study Life - School Planner
pain_points: The old version was great! The new version is not. It deleted all my information and I've tried multiple ways to transfer my data over like they suggested, and it won't work. This isn't any better than any other app now. Will probably not be using it again. *edit: I was finally able to export my data but when I went to import it, some information was excluded. Also, it keeps displaying the wrong date on the calender even though the event is currently set up. Very irritating and useless.

Loved the old version, hate the new update. The old version was simple and easy to look at and navigate. The new version is unintuitive; instead of separate buttons for creating assignments, classes, and exams, it's now tabs under the same create button, which is confusing. Also, the colors in the new version are egregious and cause me physical pain to look at because of an eye condition I have. The yellow is unreadable. You can't have separate lines or terms. Holidays can't be one day only now.

Was working great until it deleted my account. I guess they had a massive revamp or something, since all of my tracked assignments were wiped. Thanks, glad to know I can count on you guys. Edit: According to other reviews, the app had a massive update and not a single person's assignment data was saved and transferred over. There's an option to transfer them via screenshot, but no warning was given beforehand. This is extremely unprofessional, especially in the middle of the fall semester.

As you can see from the most recent reviews, people are not happy with this update. I've been using this app for years and it's been awesome, but this new update didn't transfer over any of my assignments, incorrectly transferred my schedule, and the new interface just isn't intuitive. Also, not sure whose idea it was to implement this change almost halfway through the fall semester, but that was seriously a terrible idea. Really disappointed.

I used to rely on this app for everything school related. The ability to track assignments and due dates for the whole semester was supremely helpful. However, not only did they release an update a quarter of the way through the 2024 semester, but none of the old data was ported to the new system. Not even login information. Not only that, but now, every time I try to go in and change something, the app crashes every 30 seconds. I see the vision, but wait for the final version.

Students & Study Utilities.title: School Planner
pain_points: I like the idea of it and I like being able to organize my assignments and tests. Although, "Back up and Restore" and putting my email in does not work on the app and it is saying there is an error and I used different emails and devices. I find this to be very frustrating because I wanted to sync it up to my phone and I'm not doing twice the work just for this disappointing app. In order for this app to get more than 1 star, it needs to live up to it's description and advertisement.

Not cool. I enjoyed using this app as my primary tracker for school but I was extremely annoyed and sick of the ads and decided to pay for the premium. Now I am paying for the premium version listed as "ad-free" ---yet the ads are still there. They almost seem longer now. Need customer support because I shouldn't pay and still be watching ads when trying to study.

It was working great for a year but then I got a new phone and now it gives me a 5 second ad every time I open it. The ads have volume which makes it very annoying to use in class because you have to mute your phone or else you will distract everyone. Sometimes you can't even close the app without it crashing and when you reopen it, it plays another ad.

The app is cool although a bit confusing at the start, maybe a short tutorial would be nice. There are too many ads, I don't mind some of them here and there but every time I click on something I get a 1 on 2 chance to get one. And i don't know if it's only on my phone (Xiaomi Redmi note 7), but the app makes it restart in a loop. That's why I removed it, and that's why I gave this app a 1 star review.

Do not reccomend. These are the things I would change about the timetables: Should be much more customizable, for example it should allow stretching out or shrinking the columns, it should allow changing default frequency and much more... Ads are a little excessive, but all these problems probably solve themselves once you purchase premium... Today we can't even have a digital planner for free. Also why does the app return to the current day whenever you go out of the app??
